session.title: rn that achieves a purpose from a request alone

goals.what: Whoever wants to hand a whole piece of work to an agent asks for it without preparing anything, only answers what they are asked, and their purpose is achieved; rn 0.10.0 brings this to them.
goals.why: Work that takes days then reaches a merged result with the user called only for their own decisions, deciding each sign-off from the proposal alone and going on from the record the next day, as issue #54 says.

acceptance_criteria.what: On real requests, the user sends back few changes at the deliverable sign-off, none once G1 is reached.
On the same requests, the user spends little time from asking to their purpose achieved, with AC1 no worse.
